source: Browser research on the five same-name questions, 14 Aug 2026, at Cyan's direction ('go look online in the browser')
method: Settled by hard identifiers (tt ids, casts, platform's own pages), never by resemblance.

rulings.question: Fallen for My Best Friend's Dad (fan list) vs our falling-for-my-bestie-s-dad
rulings.evidence: Fan-list title is tt35230395 (2024, ReelShort; Sophia Delucchi, Edwin Modlin II, Prymrr, Toby S. Pruett). Ours already carries tt43634344 with Evah Doheny credited. Two tt ids.
rulings.action: Fan-list title becomes a real import candidate: platform reelshort, imdb_id tt35230395.

rulings.question: My Ex's Best Friends (fan list) vs Faking It With My Ex's Best Friend (ReelShort)
rulings.evidence: My Ex's Best Friends is its own series, tt36433156 (2025; Natalie Collins, Jeff Lawless, Travis Long, Richmond Keeling; weekend-getaway premise). Faking It stars Maria Barseghian in a school setting.
rulings.action: Import candidate, but NO PLATFORM NAMED anywhere found yet (only Dailymotion re-uploads surfaced). Waits under the production-house rule.

rulings.question: Evil Stepmom Survival Guide (fan list) vs Survival Guide for the Hated Stepmom (DramaBox)
rulings.evidence: Evil Stepmom Survival Guide is tt36129137 (2025), cast Sophia Delucchi, Jake Hobbs, Freddy Piazza, Dana Ruilova, streaming on KALOSTV (their own YouTube/Facebook branding). DramaBox's title is a different premise entirely.
rulings.action: Import candidate: platform kalostv, imdb_id tt36129137. Would give KalosTV its first real entry, and Jake Hobbs is already a tracked actor.

rulings.question: Divorced at the Wedding Day: our title matched THREE DramaBox bookIds
rulings.answer: ONE PRODUCTION, LISTED THREE TIMES BY DRAMABOX
rulings.evidence: bookIds 42000013146, 42000012336, 42000010362 all serve chapterCount 51, ENGLISH, same title. Ours is tt37178859 with 51 episodes. DramaBox's own catalogue carries duplicate entries - the ambiguity was theirs, not two productions.
rulings.action: APPLIED 14 Aug: the pinedrama row was re-pointed to dramabox with the 42000013146 link. One of the PineDrama 64 resolved.

rulings.question: Trope vocabulary: childhood sweetheart/s, contract lover/s, athlete/s
rulings.evidence: Semantic judgement about her vocabulary, not a fact a browser can settle. 30 tag assignments held back until ruled.

note: DramaBox duplicate bookIds are a new trap: the same series can appear under several ids in their catalogue, so 'name maps to several bookIds' does not always mean same-name collision - compare chapterCount and language before assuming two productions.
